Attached: 1 image

Immich v3.4.0 is out! 📸 The open-source photo and video manager brings several long-awaited features:

✨ Tags are finally available in the mobile app
🖼️ Native JPEG XL image support
⚙️ Expanded workflows with OCR text filters, OCR triggers, and EXIF presence matching

The update will roll out on PikaPods in a few days.

Release notes: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases/tag/v3.4.0
Run Immich: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=immich

#opensource #privacy
